content: धर्मिन् {%a.%} [धर्मोऽस्त्यस्य-इनि] .²1 Virtuous, just, pious. .²2 Knowing oneʼs duties. .²3 Obeying the law. .²4 Having the properties of, having the nature, peculiar properties or characteristics of anything (at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>); षट् सुता द्विजधर्मिणः <ls>Ms. 10. 41</ls>; कल्पवृक्षफलधर्मि काङ्क्षितम् <ls>R. 11. 50</ls>. .²5 Following the habits of any person. --{%m.%} An epithet of Viṣṇu.
